base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished original Calgary Crocs underwater-hockey club app concept inspired by the provided Twinsi reference UI, NOT the previous black/orange Orb designs. Input image 1 home is visual reference for white fades, immersive 3D scene, condensed bold typography and thin outlined surfaces; image 2 health is reference for clean data UI, black icons, very light gray outlines and orange-to-hot-pink progress gradients. Adapt the visual system rather than copying exact layouts. Bright pure white canvas #FFFFFF, nearblack text #141414, secondary gray #6B6B6B, subtle surface #F5F5F3 and border #E5E5E3. Athletic condensed bold headings resembling Roboto Condensed, neutral Inter-like body. Friendly high quality 3D poolside illustration ONLY in Home hero, secondary views predominantly clean flat white UI. 24px card radii, pill controls, restrained soft shadows only for floating layers, spacious but compact purposeful hierarchy. Primary CTA black pill with white label; orange #FF642D to vivid pink #FF0AA8 gradient reserved for progress, not every control. RSVP green #168454 and red #BA3E48 paired with explicit selected checkmarks. Black outline icons, selected tabs pale gray pill, selected bottom nav black with label. Actual app not a marketing page, no prose commentary outside screens, no crypto, invented AI chat, money, step counts, reward currencies, fitness weights/reps, or trophies. Accurate readable text, no watermarks, no hockey stick illustrations. Fictional people Alex Rivera (You), Sam Rivera and Mila Rivera, coach Casey Morgan. Bottom nav Home, Schedule, Messages, Account, Club; safe-area clearance with no covered content. Board with two complete large front-facing phone screen designs side-by-side on a very pale gray background, not tilted, no hardware frames. Each phone approx 390x844 logical pixels, all content well spaced and fits.

sets.name: 01-system
sets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a beautiful landscape DESIGN SYSTEM SPECIMEN BOARD for an original Calgary Crocs club app inspired by attached Twinsi references. White studio/editorial canvas, understated black text, condensed athletic bold headings like Roboto Condensed and Inter body, thin light gray hairline outlines, light gray pill controls, soft white card shapes. Title 'CROCS / POOLSIDE' subtitle 'Product design system'. A clear ordered grid with generous gutters. Top left color swatches labeled Canvas #FFFFFF, Ink #141414, Surface #F5F5F3, Border #E5E5E3, Muted #6B6B6B. Separate gradient swatch #FF642D to #FF0AA8 labeled 'Progress'; semantic Green #168454 and Red #BA3E48. Show a small typography specimen 'Thursday training' in condensed bold and readable body '7:45–9:30 PM · MNP Sport Centre'. Show COMPONENTS: primary black 'Check in' pill, secondary white outlined 'View plan' pill, selected pale gray 'Upcoming' tab beside unselected 'Past', icon button bell with 44px target label, thin black outline calendar/message/profile icons. Show compact RSVP row 'You' with green selected check Yes and neutral No, a second sample selected red No. Show 3/6 horizontal gradient progress bar exactly half filled. Show compact swim-result row '50 m swim' / 'Best 1:30', right '1:30' with green DOWN arrow '0:03' below. Small 3D illustration sample of cheerful tasteful green crocodile bust in a softly sunlit indoor pool scene with water reflections, no sports gear or words. Tiny annotations '4px spacing base', '24px cards', 'Pill controls', '44px touch targets', 'Scene → white fade'. No dark panels, orange CTA spam, giant mascot, invented AI feature, or decorative chart nonsense. This is a precise visual specimen board not a page of prose; typography and UI have priority over illustration.
